query.description: Optional. Number of jobs, up to twenty, that will be returned at one time.
Optional. Use this string, provided with the response to a previous request, to request the next batch of jobs.
Optional. When you request lists of resources, you can specify whether they are sorted in ASCENDING or DESCENDING order. Default varies by resource.
Optional. Provide a queue name to get back only jobs from that queue.
Optional. A job's status can be SUBMITTED, PROGRESSING, COMPLETE, CANCELED, or ERROR.
Pagination limit
Pagination token

request.description: Retrieve a JSON array of up to twenty of your most recently created jobs. This array includes in-process, completed, and errored jobs. This will return the jobs themselves, not just a list of the jobs. To retrieve the twenty next most recent jobs, use the nextToken string returned with the array.

response.name: Success
